title: The Twelve Dancing Princesses
description: Every morning twelve princesses wake with their dancing shoes worn through. A curious traveller follows them through a hidden staircase into a glittering midnight world.
catalogueBlurb: Twelve worn-out pairs of shoes hide a glittering midnight secret.

cover.alt: Arthur Rackham's illustration for The Twelve Dancing Princesses.

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on the Brothers Grimm public-domain tale
text.notes: The underlying Grimm tale is public domain; this wording is an original child-friendly Unicorn Valley retelling.

illustrations.source: Arthur Rackham illustrations for the 1909 English edition
illustrations.notes: The selected Rackham source files are identified as public domain on Wikimedia Commons. Rackham died in 1939.

The complete Twelve Dancing Princesses wording is retained without abridgement or modernisation; Project Gutenberg front matter and licence boilerplate are excluded.
